description: DuckDuckGo Search. Query DuckDuckGo via API and retrieve structured organic results with region and language. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gl.description: Country code, for example us, fr, gb, de, jp.

hl.description: Language code, for example en, fr, de, ja, zh.

page.description: Page number. Page 1 is the first page of results. Default: 1.

query.description: Search query sent to DuckDuckGo Search.

name: duckduckgo_search
title: DuckDuckGo Search
